headline: Maddison scores in 'dream' return as Spurs get 1st EPL win of season
description: An emotional James Maddison said it was like a "dream" to produce a goal and help Tottenham climb off the bottom of the Premier League with a 3-1 home win.

headline: Kulusevski returns as Spurs get first Premier League win of season
description: Tottenham Hotspur climbed off the bottom of the Premier League after James Maddison's superb 14th-minute opener inspired a 3-1 home win over Coventry City on Monday.

headline: Dejan Kulusevski makes Tottenham return 526 days after suffering knee injury
description: Dejan Kulusevski played his first match for 526 days on Monday after he came off the bench in the 86th minute of Tottenham's Premier League match against Coventry on Monday.
